board.question: Will the US take control of any part of Greenland? — Before 2027
board.namedSource: The New York Times (a single news outlet, named in metadata but not referenced in the criteria text itself).
board.headlineRisk: A US–Denmark/Greenland announcement of intent to transfer territory could resolve this Yes even though no land has actually changed hands, blindsiding No holders who expected an accomplished acquisition.

board.question: Will President Trump be impeached during his term? — Before Jan 20, 2029
board.namedSource: Library of Congress (generically named; presumably congress.gov records of impeachment resolutions), with no specific document or URL cited.
board.headlineRisk: The market resolves Yes the moment the House passes articles of impeachment — even if the Senate acquits and Trump finishes his term — surprising traders who think 'impeached' means 'removed.'

board.question: Will Trump invoke the Insurrection Act? — Before 2027
board.namedSource: The White House plus a broad list of major news organizations (NYT, AP, Reuters, Axios, Politico, Semafor, The Information, WaPo, WSJ, ABC, CBS, CNN, Fox News, MSNBC).
board.headlineRisk: Trump federalizes and deploys the National Guard to US cities under non-Insurrection-Act authority (as he has done), troops are visibly on the streets, yet the market resolves No because the Insurrection Act was never formally invoked.

board.question: Will Trump resign during his term? — Before his term ends
board.namedSource: No specific authoritative document is named — only the vague 'Office of the Presidency'; a genuine resignation would be evidenced by a written instrument to the Secretary of State, but the criteria don't cite it.
board.headlineRisk: Trump leaves office early via the 25th Amendment, impeachment, or death and the market still resolves No because the text requires an actual 'resignation.'

board.question: How much will the US acquire Greenland for? — $0 / No Acquisition
board.namedSource: The New York Times — a single newspaper, used to confirm whether any qualifying acquisition occurred during Trump's term.
board.headlineRisk: A high-profile Trump 'announcement' or a Compact-style arrangement could be ruled an 'Acquisition' and flip this bracket to No, even though no money changed hands and most observers think nothing concrete happened.

board.question: Who will be Trump's next Attorney General? — Lee Zeldin
board.namedSource: No single named source; resolution is to be based on reporting from a list of 14 major news outlets (ABC, Fox, MSNBC, WSJ, Semafor, The Information, CBS, Axios, CNN, Reuters, WaPo, AP, Politico, NYT).
board.headlineRisk: If a different person was already confirmed as AG, the 'first new person to be Attorney General' has arguably already occurred, so Zeldin could be locked out of a Yes no matter what later happens — a settlement that contradicts the 'next AG' framing of the title.

board.question: Will Trump be impeached and removed from office? — Before his term ends
board.namedSource: The U.S. Senate's conviction vote on articles of impeachment.
board.headlineRisk: A House impeachment with no Senate conviction — which has already happened to Trump twice — would still resolve this market No, surprising traders who equate 'impeached' with the headline.

board.question: Will the US issue a Level 4 travel advisory for Taiwan? — Before Jul 1, 2026
board.namedSource: The U.S. State Department's official travel advisories website, where an advisory counts as issued once it appears with an official publication date.
board.headlineRisk: The market hinges on Taiwan being placed at the highest 'Do not travel' level — a major geopolitical escalation it is currently nowhere near — so the likeliest surprise is simply a No that traders chasing tail risk over-price.
